title: Staggered activation & role-based enablement for Dashboards + Cost Breakdown
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate a multi-wave rollout for the new Dashboards and Cost Breakdown features with role-targeted enablement, release notes coordination, and cross-functional go-to-market tasks. This ticket centralizes launch sequencing, UXR signoff checkpoints, and the activation gating policy for enterprise tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Feature flags exist for per-tenant and per-route activation and are documented in the API spec.
Role-based training materials produced and reviewed by Support and Sales (Engineer, FinOps, Product).
Release notes drafted and approved by Product, Legal, and Communications.
QA smoke tests pass for activation toggle, data correctness and billing reconciliation in staging.
Canary rollout executed with monitoring dashboards and rollback procedure validated.
tasks: Finalize activation toggle API and add RBAC checks (ENG).
Create training deck and role-based cheat sheets (Docs & PM).
Draft and review release notes with Legal and Comms.
Prepare customer beta list and coordinate 1:1 onboarding slots (CS).
Set up monitoring dashboards for adoption and billing drift checks.
Schedule localization of training content into DE/FR and track progress.
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Kickoff with Design and Eng. Agreed on three activation waves: internal dogfood, beta customers, general availability.
2026-02-22: UX signoff for dashboard visual language; cost breakdown v1 approved with privacy guardrails.
2026-03-01: Engineering provided stability gating metrics; added auto-fallback for senior customers if latency >600ms for telemetry routes.
2026-03-05: Docs and Training deck draft completed; feedback loop started with Support & Sales.
2026-03-09: Finalized activation toggles and per-tenant rollout API; scheduled canary for 2026-03-16.
decisions: Rollout will use three waves (internal -> beta -> GA) to limit blast radius.
Enablement materials will be role-based (Engineer, FinOps, Product) and localized into EN/DE/FR for top regions.
Release notes will include an 'impact and mitigation' section for customers on Reserved/Dedicated plans.
risks: Billing reconciliation may mismatch during beta if tokenization changes are not captured.
Complexity of per-tenant toggles increases test matrix for QA.
Localization delays could push non-EN enablement by two weeks.
risks_mitigation: Add pre-launch end-to-end billing smoke test; engage billing infra team (ENG-19811).
Prioritize automated rollout tests and pair with Reliability SRE.
Publish English materials at GA and add a localized update window in communications.
QA_plan: End-to-end checklist including: activation toggle smoke, permission matrix verification, dashboard data correctness against test dataset, cost breakdown reconciliation across time windows, and latency SLO checks. Automated test PR will run nightly; manual signoff from Support on sample tenants before each wave.
rollout_plan: Wave 1 (internal) 2026-03-16: feature flags enabled for internal accounts; monitoring and feedback collection. Wave 2 (beta) 2026-03-23: invite selected customers with dedicated comms and 1:1 onboarding. Wave 3 (GA) 2026-04-06: progressive rollout across regions, release notes pushed to console and email, enablement webinars scheduled.
training_plan: Engineer office hours: 2 sessions covering API and toggles
FinOps webinar: cost breakdown walkthrough + Q&A
Support playbook: triage runbook + final checklist
notes: Ensure KMS audit logging is enabled for customers on Private deployments before GA.
Coordinate with Legal on wording for data retention in cost breakdown slices.
estimated_impact: Expected to improve cost visibility for high-usage customers and reduce support ticket volume related to billing by ~15% within first quarter.
follow_up: Usage funnel dashboard to track activation -> adoption -> value
